listing.formatted_address: 1075 W. Side Avenue, Jersey City, NJ 07306
listing.description: Discover a new way to live in Jersey City at West Side Square. Choose from brand-new studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments thoughtfully designed for everyday living, with spacious layouts, modern finishes, and select homes featuring dens, lofts, eat-in kitchens, and private entrances. Beyond your front door, enjoy a collection of indoor and outdoor amenities designed for relaxation, fitness, work, and connection. Spend summer days by the pool, recharge in the fitness and wellness spaces, enjoy the outdoor gathering areas, or take advantage of dedicated amenities for your four-legged roommate. Located on West Side Avenue, West Side Square puts you near Lincoln Park, Mana Contemporary, Journal Square, and destinations throughout Jersey City. Plus, resident shuttle service to and from the Journal Square PATH station makes getting connected even easier.

general.restrictions: We welcome 2 pets per apartment home. There is a $500 pet deposit (non-refundable) per pet. There is no weight restriction. Please call our Leasing Office for complete Pet Policy information.

listing.income_requirement_text: Must have 3x the rent in total household income (before taxes)
